title: Monday-morning email ('Your week ready to print')
description: Every Monday at 06:30 local, send the teacher an email summarising 'Your week ready to print: Mon Y7 Forces, Tue Y8 Algebra…' with a single 'Print all' deep link that opens /home and fires the existing PrintAll handler immediately.
rationale: User's improvement #12 (d). The email is the trigger; the WeekAheadPanel is the destination. Combined, it converts intention into action before the bell.
steps: Add server/jobs/mondayMail.ts: cron `30 6 * * 1` (configurable). For each user with `mondayEmailEnabled = true`, build the same up-to-5 cards the WeekAheadPanel builds (extract the aggregator from PR-4 into a shared module so server can call it — `server/lib/weekAheadAggregator.ts`).
Render the email with the existing transactional template engine (re-use ParentNewsletter's renderer scaffold, or whichever lives at server/lib/email/).
Subject: 'Your Adaptly week — 5 lessons ready to print'.
Body: list of 5 rows + a single 'Print all 30 booklets' button that links to https://app.adaptly.co.uk/home?action=printAll&hash=…
Home.tsx: when query carries `action=printAll`, on mount validates the hash + auto-fires WeekAheadPanel.handlePrintAll (lift the handler to a ref or imperative method).
Settings → Notifications → 'Monday-morning email' toggle (default ON for new accounts; respect existing email-prefs row).
- server/tests/jobs/mondayMail.test.ts — covers: per-user dispatch, opt-out respected, no schedulers = no email.
do_not_touch: Cron registration outside server/jobs/ (use the existing scheduler)
acceptance_criteria: A user with 3 scheduled classes receives the Monday email at 06:30 local with 3 listed lessons.
Clicking 'Print all' opens /home and immediately triggers print-all without an extra click.
Opting out via Settings prevents the email.
verification: Manual: send a test email via the admin route; click; confirm print window opens.
